page_title: SAL 2-2 SAS | Salernitana v Sassuolo 05/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+256' Stefano Colantuono has decided to substitute Loum Tchaouna and he is replaced by Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana).
90+256' Substitution. Jerome Boateng (Salernitana) replaces Konstantinos Manolas.
90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+7' Today's referee Simone Sozza rightly decides to book Emanuel Vignato (Salernitana) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
90+3' No foul! Referee Simone Sozza points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Salernitana players.
90+3' The Salernitana players halt their celebrations as referee Simone Sozza makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a foul in the build-up play.
90+3' A yellow card for a tackle by Uros Racic (Sassuolo). Simone Sozza doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Gregoire Defrel departs the field of play to be replaced by Mattia Viti (Sassuolo).

90+1' 2 - 2 It's a goal! Alessandro Zanoli plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 2:2.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
85' Substitution. Simy (Salernitana) on for Niccolo Pierozzi.
84' The corner from Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo) is hurriedly cleared.
82' The resulting corner from Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
82' Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Simone Sozza ignores the protests.
78' The resulting set piece from Sassuolo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) leaves the pitch and Emanuel Vignato comes on.
77' Substitution. Konstantinos Manolas (Salernitana) makes way for Jerome Boateng.
73' The substitution has been made. Uros Racic (Sassuolo) has replaced Kristian Thorstvedt.
73' Substitution. Nedim Bajrami is replaced by Matheus Henrique (Sassuolo).
72' Simone Sozza shows a yellow card to Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) for a tough tackle.
69' Davide Ballardini decides to make a substitution. Martin Erlic will be replaced by Marash Kumbulla (Sassuolo).
67' Simone Sozza shows the yellow card to Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) for a heavy challenge.
64' A substitution has been made. Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi is replaced by Shon Weissman (Salernitana).
63' None of the Sassuolo players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Sassuolo.
62' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) sees a yellow card from Simone Sozza after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
59' Ball possession – 51:49.
56' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) tested Benoit Costil with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
52' 1 - 2 Goal! Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Andrea Consigli to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
52' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
51' It’s a PENALTY to Salernitana after the VAR review!
51' There's a break in play and referee Simone Sozza must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Salernitana using VAR. This could be interesting!
50' One of the Salernitana players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
47' Sassuolo take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
46' Stefano Colantuono makes a switch. Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) is coming on in place of Iron Gomis at the start of the second period.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
44' 0 - 2 Goal! A mistake from the defence gifted a chance to a lurking Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo), who keeps his cool and rolls the ball into the net from close range. 0:2.
43' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
41' Sassuolo can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Nedim Bajrami tees up Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom right corner and past Benoit Costil.
36' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is penalised for a foul. Simone Sozza had a clear view and blows his whistle.
35' Iron Gomis (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.

33' What a chance that is! Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
30' After what seems an eternity, referee Simone Sozza decides there was an offside after using VAR to review the goal! NO GOAL for Sassuolo, play to continue.
29' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
28' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Sassuolo players aren’t happy.
27' The foul by Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Simone Sozza.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Sassuolo, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Iron Gomis (Salernitana) commits a rough challenge and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul.
18' A dangerous looking corner kick from Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) is cleared to safety by the defence.
18' Andrea Pinamonti (Sassuolo) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Sassuolo will have a corner.
17' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.

16' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Simone Sozza with no other option than to blow for a foul.
15' Nedim Bajrami (Sassuolo) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Benoit Costil, who smothers the ball.
14' Armand Lauriente (Sassuolo) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
11' Josh Doig (Sassuolo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
10' Jeremy Toljan (Sassuolo) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
6' Some patient build-up play from Salernitana as they look to unlock the defence.
3' Salernitana work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Salernitana will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Simone Sozza.
